name: network-diagram
description: Evaluate and improve Network Diagram drawings — servers, devices and the links between them
goal: Reach a consistent 16+/20, with every node connected and drawn from a PERIPH_M.VSSX master

prompts.text: Build a network diagram for a branch office with a firewall, switch, wireless access point, servers and workstations
Build a network diagram for two sites connected over a WAN link, each with its own router and local servers
Build a network diagram showing a DMZ between an external firewall and an internal firewall, with a web server in the DMZ
Build a network diagram for a hybrid setup with an on-premises data centre linked to a cloud environment
